g.text: Expected product behavior · US01 / US04 / US09 / US13 / US18 / US19 / US20 / US21 / US25 / US26 / US27
Create Driver account and User Profile
Enter license plate and descriptive data
Show field error; preserve existing Vehicles
Use foreground location or default area
Select Vehicle, zone, spot and valid schedule
Hold spot temporarily and submit payment
Wait for approved or rejected notification
Create Reserved Reservation and Virtual Receipt
Open Google Maps or compatible web fallback
Show destination unavailable; do not invent route
Validate compatibility, hours and later Reservations
Valid assignment and any difference paid?
Recalculate amount and update Virtual Receipt
Cancel, release spot and request full Refund
Driver or Parking Admin confirms check-in
Mark Active; preserve original end time
Still occupied after end plus 5-minute tolerance?
Calculate Additional Charge by configured fraction
Apply active plan discount once: 0%, 10% or 15%
Record Outstanding Balance; block new Reservations
Offer retry or another payment method
Early departure keeps spot protected until reserved end
Release hold and report failed payment
No Reservation and no Virtual Receipt
Explain missing Vehicle, balance or availability
Offer the relevant correction or another zone
View Free, Plus Monthly and Plus Annual
Submit purchase and wait for approved payment
Keep current plan; show payment failure
Cancel renewal; retain benefits through applicable date
Select Reservation, Subscription or Additional Charge
View applicable Virtual Receipt, Electronic Receipt or Invoice
Show linked Refund or Outstanding Balance when applicable
Download PDF or send to registered email
Sign out or require authentication after Session expiry
Find and reserve · US01 / US04 / US25
This userflow describes requirements, not implementation evidence.
Wireflows identify existing screens and pending prototype connections.
No-show: operational sensor never records Occupied throughout the reserved period;
release spot and refund. Reassignment: compatible alternative and updated receipt;
otherwise offer another facility or cancel with full refund.
Theme/language switching is excluded. Accessibility remains a cross-cutting requirement.
